verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI can fetch models from Hugging Face and Ollama sources (huggingface:// and ollama:// URIs) and run GGUF files. Nothing documents whether its downloaded model files or caches are stored in a layout other runtimes can reuse, or whether it can reuse another runtime's existing cache without re-downloading or re-converting. Fetching from a registry is a different capability from cache interoperability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether downloaded model files and caches can be reused by other runtimes without re-downloading or re-converting them
